Melt it down to slag!'|[[Dooku/Legends|Dooku]], ordering two [[Neimoidian/Legends|Neimoidian]] [[Neimoidian Gunnery Battalion|guards]] to fire on a [[Unidentified B1 battle droid (Separatist factory)|B1 battle droid]]|<ref name="Update">{{TCWComicCite|6.53|Update}}</ref>}}
These blaster rifles were wielded by the [[Neimoidian/Legends|Neimoidian]] [[Neimoidian Gunnery Battalion|guards]] and warriors during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. It was rather unwieldy and meant mainly for ceremonial purposes.
